summary: Separates the three part records on a unit: the 30h class-side part descriptors in class+18h, the 1ACh damage-state model instance at unit+360h, and the per-part physics and detach state that lives on the unit motion controller at unit+1018h. Reads 00934150 in full, decodes the 00958A30 sub-object branch, and identifies 00821E80 as the receiver of unit message kind 99h rather than a damage threshold.

routines.name: BSP_UnitParts_DetachPart
routines.abi: __thiscall(controller, int index, const float impulse[3]), RET 8
routines.coverage: complete for the control flow and every named call site; the 14h-byte group entry layout and the debris spec fields are contract: unread
routines.evidence: 1422 instructions from python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm 00934150. Part record base from SHL EAX,5 at 00934176 and LEA EDI,[EAX+ESI] at 0093417A with the first field read at [EDI+90h] (00934180). Group slot from MOVSX EDI,byte ptr [ECX+ESI+34Ch] at 00934356 with JL 00935520 at 00934366.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_DetachPart
routines.evidence: Reads unit+1018h, zeroes a stack vec3 and calls 00934150 at 0080E467; ADD ESP,0xC at 0080E46C proves the callee popped the two pushed arguments.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_HandleMessage
routines.coverage: partial: the 99h case is read in full; the other 26 switch targets are located but not read
routines.evidence: MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [ESI+10h] / ADD EAX,-4Bh / CMP EAX,55h / JA 0082237B at 00821E9D-00821EAA, then MOVZX EAX,[EAX+822400h] and JMP [EAX*4+822394h]. Table bytes read with ghidra bytes 00822394 --length 194: target index 13h is 00821FF0 and byte 4Eh of the index table selects it, so the message kind is 4Bh+4Eh = 99h.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_ReactToHealthChange
routines.coverage: complete for the sub-object branch 00958A58-00958DA6; the six virtual slots it dispatches are contract: unread
routines.evidence: Branch entry at 00958A63 (COMISS XMM1,XMM0 on +370h) and 00958A6D (CMP byte [ESI+720h],0). Break path 00958A7A-00958BC4, repeat path 00958BD5-00958CD3, repair path 00958CD4-00958DA6, root path 00958DA7-00958DCF.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_ResetCondition
routines.evidence: 00878340 at 0080E413, then 1.0f (00D7A24C) into +9D8h and +9DCh and the bytes +9E4h and +9E5h cleared. One call site 00758373; eight DATA references (00CF9268, 00CFA930, 00CFB8F0, 00CFC588, 00CFFBE8, 00D09830, 00D0C138, 00D0C800) put it in vtables, slot unread.

routines.name: BSP_UnitPartInstance_Construct
routines.coverage: complete for the fields it writes; its five helper calls are contract: unread
routines.evidence: Writes +0h (two vptrs), +4Ch, +160h, +164h, +16Ch/+170h/+174h = 0, +17Ch, +184h, +18Ch, +198h and zeroes up to +1A8h, which fits the 1ACh allocation at 0087BE1C.

routines.name: BSP_UnitController_BuildSubObjectsAndHullBody
routines.coverage: partial: read only for the writes to +310h, +320h/+330h/+340h and +34Ch and for its node-name strings; the rest of 00937C90-00939C8F is unread
routines.evidence: MOV byte ptr [EDI+EBP+34Ch],0FFh at 0093813A and MOV byte ptr [EDI+EBP+34Ch],AL at 009381B5 with AL from the running counter at [ESP+18h]; +310h/+314h at 009383C9/009383E1/009383FC; +330h/+334h at 0093919D/009391AB. Strings 00CEB90C fizika_%02d, 00CEB900 ep_fizika, 00D1968C firstnode, 00D19698 back, 00D196A0 front, 00D196A8 the Hungarian missing-collider diagnostic.

routines.name: BSP_UnitController_Construct
routines.coverage: reused as the producer of the part record array; already reconstructed in docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md
routines.evidence: eh_vector_constructor_iterator(this+8Ch, 20h, 14h, 009318D0, 0092FD50) gives 20 records of 20h bytes at +8Ch..+30Bh, which is exactly the array 00934150 indexes.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_CreateMotionController
routines.evidence: PUSH 390h at 0080DED7, operator new 00BF681B at 0080DEDE, 00939CB0 at 0080DEF9, MOV [ESI+1018h],EAX at 0080DF06. Found by searching the program for the byte pattern 89 86 18 10 00 00, which also returns the variants 007497D6 and 00857C66.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_LastDamageStateIndex
routines.evidence: Reads unit+360h; when [inst+16Ch] is non-null and ([inst+170h]-[inst+16Ch])>>4 is non-zero it returns that count minus one, otherwise 0. Its result is the argument of vtable[1B4h] at 00958ADC and 00958C11.

routines.name: BSP_UnitParts_DetachAllLiveParts
routines.coverage: reused from docs/UNIT_DAMAGE_AND_DEATH.md as the only writer of controller+310h after the build
routines.evidence: Walks [controller+310h, controller+314h), stores -10000.0f (00D19620) for every entry above 0.0f and calls 00934150 at 00935D16.

corrections.was: a breakable-parts object with a per-part health vector at +310h, writer not found (docs/UNIT_DAMAGE_AND_DEATH.md)
corrections.is: the unit motion controller of docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md, allocated at 0080DEC0 as 390h bytes and constructed by 00939CB0
corrections.evidence: The byte pattern 89 86 18 10 00 00 has three matches, 007497D6, 0080DF06 and 00857C66; 0080DEC0's whole body is PUSH 390h / 00BF681B / 00939CB0 / MOV [ESI+1018h],EAX.

corrections.what: the parts vector on the unit
corrections.was: the vector at this+344h with the elements at this+344h (docs/UNIT_HIT_PATH.md)
corrections.is: the vector object is at +344h; its begin is +348h and its end +34Ch
corrections.evidence: LEA EBP,[ESI+344h] at 0087BD46 is the resize this; the elements are read at [EBP+4] (0087BD58) and [EBP+8] (0087BD5F). 0087BF80 reads the same pair directly as [ESI+348h] and [ESI+34Ch] at 0087C070 and 0087C07E.

corrections.was: expected to be the caller that decides to detach a part on a damage threshold
corrections.is: the unit message handler; its case for kind 99h forwards [msg+20h] to 0080E440 with no test at all
corrections.evidence: The switch head at 00821E9D-00821EB7 and the two jump tables at 00822394 and 00822400. No threshold anywhere on the path; the sender of kind 99h is unread.

unread: The 30h part descriptor fields in class+18h and the routine that fills that vector; neither 00960230 nor 0087CA80 writes +18h..+20h.
The sender of unit message kind 99h and how it chooses the part index.
Whether the controller part index (0..19) and the entries of unit+344h are the same index space.
The 14h-byte group entry layout beyond the node pointer at +0h and the four dwords copied into the debris spec.
The six virtual slots 00958A30 dispatches and the class ids 45h, 46h and 1Bh.
Which vtable slot 0080E410 occupies in the eight vtables that reference it.
